dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Ms. Velázquez (for herself, Mr. Loudermilk, Mr. Foster, and Mr. Hollingsworth) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To regulate lobbying by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac Lobbying Regulation Act of 2019.

section.header: Limitations on lobbying activity by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
section.text: Part 3 of subtitle A of the Federal Housing Enterprises Financial Safety and Soundness Act of 1992 (12 U.S.C. 4601 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following new section:

section.header: Limitations on lobbying activity by enterprises
section.text: During any period in which an enterprise is in conservatorship or receivership pursuant to section 1367, such enterprise may not engage in any activity that would result in such enterprise being a client for purposes of section 3(2) of the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 (2 U.S.C. 1602(2)).
